name: zoolutions
description: Shared Claude Code machinery for our repositories. Knowledge stays in each repo (AGENTS.md → ## Workflow); the workflow and the stack specialists live here, once.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Every repository: /flow:lfg (issue to merge-ready PR), /flow:follow-through (epic to merged, unattended), /flow:finish-prs, /flow:plan (incl. upstream fixes carried to a release), /flow:effort, /flow:github-review-*, /flow:tdd, /flow:review-pr, /flow:debug-flaky, flow:fable-validator.

plugins.name: rails-app
plugins.description: Rails applications (Phlex, DaisyUI, phlex-reactive, ActionPolicy, RSpec): the layer specialists, AppSignal debugging and triage.

plugins.name: ruby-gem
plugins.description: Ruby libraries: an unattended release (version, changelog, frozen lockfiles), branch-versus-main benchmarks.

plugins.name: machine
plugins.description: Every machine agents run on: /machine:reap reports and reaps leftover agent processes (orphans, stale wait loops, runners in removed worktrees, headless or idle claude sessions) and keeps test runs at background priority. Enabled per machine at user scope; its schedule and SessionStart line are wired from its README.
